entities.summary: Kentaro James Shibuya Lloyd , better known as Ken Lloyd, is a British-born musician and singer-songwriter based in Japan. Fluent in both Japanese and English, he writes lyrics in both languages. He is currently in Oblivion Dust, Atom on Sphere and Fake?, the latter of which is now his solo project.
